titleZh: 国家知识产权局令（第79号）集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定
titleEn: Provisions on the Registration and Administration of Collective Marks and Certification Marks (CNIPA Order No. 79)
sumZh: 自2024年2月1日起施行的部门规章，规范集体商标、证明商标注册和使用管理，明确地理标志作为集体商标、证明商标注册的申请要求与正当使用情形。
sumEn: A regulation effective 1 Feb 2024 governing collective and certification marks, including requirements for registering GIs as such marks and fair-use scenarios.

srcZh: 北京市知识产权局（中国知识产权报）
srcEn: Beijing Intellectual Property Office (via China IP News)
titleZh: 《集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定》将于2月1日起施行，这些重点值得关注
titleEn: Key Points of the Collective and Certification Marks Regulation Effective 1 February
sumZh: 解读《集体商标、证明商标注册和管理规定》重点，介绍注册人管理职责、使用人要求及他人正当使用地名等具体情形。
sumEn: Highlights the regulation's key points, including registrant duties, user requirements and fair use of place names by others.

titleZh: 原产地证明商标就是地理标志吗
titleEn: Is a Certificate-of-Origin Mark the Same as a Geographical Indication?
sumZh: 法律解答辨析原产地证明商标与地理标志的定义、性质、注册管理及使用条件的联系与区别，帮助正确理解两种标志。
sumEn: A legal Q&A distinguishing certificate-of-origin marks from geographical indications in definition, nature, registration and usage conditions.

titleZh: 地理标志系列之五——地理标志、原产地名称与原产地证明商标的关系
titleEn: GI Series V: The Relationship Among GIs, Appellations of Origin and Certificate-of-Origin Marks
sumZh: 从地理标志、原产地名称、原产地证明商标三个概念入手，说明其定义、特征及我国将地理标志和原产地名称纳入证明商标制度保护的方式。
sumEn: Explains the definitions and features of GIs, appellations of origin and certificate-of-origin marks, and how China protects the first two via its certification-mark system.

titleZh: 我国“地理标志商标”和“证明商标”解析
titleEn: Analysis of GI Marks and Certification Marks in China
sumZh: 解析证明商标的定义、特征，梳理原产地证明商标与地理标志、原产地名称的关系，并说明证明商标注册人资格、使用管理规则及与普通商标的区别。
sumEn: Analyzes the definition and features of certification marks, their relation to GIs and appellations of origin, and registration rules and differences from ordinary marks.

titleZh: 地理标志证明商标知识科普
titleEn: Popular Science on GI Certification Marks
sumZh: 介绍地理标志证明商标的法律规定、可申请的产品类型、注册意义与好处、注册数量产值及有效期等基础知识。
sumEn: Introduces the legal basis, eligible products, benefits, statistics and validity of GI certification marks.

titleZh: 一篇搞懂地理标志证明商标，以及与普通商标的区别
titleEn: A Complete Guide to GI Certification Marks and Their Differences from Ordinary Marks
sumZh: 解释地理标志证明商标的“地理关联性”与“品质证明性”两大核心要求，并从意义、主体、权利性质、标识构成、保护侧重点等方面对比其与普通商标的区别。
sumEn: Explains the two core requirements of GI certification marks and contrasts them with ordinary marks in meaning, subject, rights, composition and protection focus.

titleZh: 一文搞懂｜地理标志商标、地理标志保护产品和农产品地理标志
titleEn: Understanding GI Marks, GI Products and Agricultural GI in One Article
sumZh: 梳理地理标志商标、地理标志保护产品、农产品地理标志三大保护体系的法律依据、定义、主管部门与审批程序，帮助厘清概念差异。
sumEn: Clarifies the legal basis, definitions, authorities and procedures of the three GI protection systems: GI marks, GI products and agricultural GIs.

titleZh: 一文读懂国家地理标志：从概念到保护体系
titleEn: Understanding National Geographical Indications: From Concept to Protection System
sumZh: 介绍国家地理标志产品的定义、三大保护体系及2024年《地理标志统一认定制度实施方案》实施后的“五统一”变革。
sumEn: Introduces the definition of national GI products, the three protection systems, and the "five unifications" reform after the 2024 GI unified recognition plan.
